title: NVIDIA launches DLSS 5 with neural rendering and promises 5× more performance on RTX 50 GPUs
summary: The new version of the upscaling technology arrives on September 3 with NBA 2K27 and will be available on all RTX 50 series, laptops, and GeForce NOW.

title: NVIDIA invests $3.5 billion in MediaTek to develop chips with RTX GPU and NVLink Fusion
summary: The alliance aims to create alternatives to NVIDIA's own GPUs by integrating its technology into MediaTek SoCs for PCs and laptops.

title: OpenAI prepares Astra model with critical cybersecurity and system penetration capabilities
summary: The new model stands out for its ability to compromise computer systems, sparking debate about its frontier safeguards.

title: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.1: better coding, research, and 45% cheaper
summary: The update reduces restrictions and costs, and introduces significant improvements in coding and research tasks.

title: Tim Cook steps down as Apple CEO after 15 years and John Ternus takes over with promise of major launch
summary: The new CEO sends his first memo anticipating a 'major launch next week' as Cook bids an emotional farewell.

title: Sony argues in court that buyers of digital games on PlayStation are never owners
summary: The company argues that reasonable consumers are not deceived into believing they own the games, and the class-action lawsuit may not go to trial.

title: Steam Deck surpasses 30,000 verified and playable games in its catalog
summary: Valve's handheld reaches a compatibility milestone as rumors suggest Steam Frame will include Half-Life: Alyx for free.

title: AI bug hunters overwhelm Linux kernel maintainers with 2,000 vulnerabilities per release
summary: Automated scanning of 40 million lines of code generates an avalanche of CVEs that developers describe as 'completely overwhelming.'

title: MacBook Neo irreversibly wears out its SSD by writing 900 GB in 3 hours due to having only 8 GB of RAM
summary: The lack of unified memory forces intensive swap usage, drastically shortening the lifespan of the soldered storage.

title: NVIDIA 616.56 drivers cause flickering on 8-bit monitors and the company is already working on a fix
summary: The update introduces a bug affecting displays configured at 8-bit color, officially acknowledged by NVIDIA.

title: Samsung launches Galaxy Book6 with Intel Wildcat Lake, 8 GB RAM and 256 GB SSD starting at $799
summary: The budget laptop hits the market with modest specifications and a price that some consider uncompetitive.
